name: schedule_field_dispatch
description: schedule_field_dispatch: Schedule a field technician to visit the employee's location to inspect or repair hardware. Checks technician availability for the requested date and time window. Returns a dispatch confirmation ID and appointment details.

employee_id.description: The employee requesting the dispatch (e.g. EMP048271).

building_code.description: The building where the device is located (e.g. BLD3).

floor_code.description: The floor where the device is located (e.g. FL2).

preferred_date.description: Preferred dispatch date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-08-15).

time_window.description: Preferred time window. morning = 08:00–12:00; afternoon = 12:00–17:00; full_day = 08:00–17:00.
